normalFinding.default: Skin warm, dry and of normal colour without rashes, lesions, pallor, cyanosis or jaundice.

steps: Look over the exposed skin in good light, including the hands and lower legs.
Note colour, any rashes or lesions, and their distribution.
Feel the skin for temperature and moisture.

normalFinding.default: Skin turgor normal; pinched skin returns promptly.

steps: Gently pinch a fold of skin, for example over the back of the hand or below the clavicle.
Release and watch how quickly it flattens.
